title: شمعی به یاد بانوی بهشت (ایام فاطمیه)
prompt:
Shot 1 — Door:
Cinematic slow push-in toward an old weathered wooden door with iron rings in a narrow mud-brick alley of ancient Medina at night. Soft silver moonlight, a single small oil lamp flickering beside the door, fine dust drifting in a moonbeam. Completely empty scene, no people, no figures, no faces. Mournful, quiet, sacred atmosphere, deep blues and warm amber, shallow depth of field, film grain.

Shot 2 — Candles:
Close-up of many slender white candles burning on dark stone, white jasmine (yas) flowers scattered around them, slow gentle dolly sideways, warm candlelight bokeh, a few white petals slowly falling through the frame. No people, no hands, no faces. Mournful, serene, elegant, cinematic macro, dark background.

Shot 3 — Mosque:
Silhouette of a mosque dome and minaret against a deep blue night sky with a full moon, black mourning flags gently waving in the wind in the foreground, slow upward tilt, thin clouds passing the moon. No people, no figures. Solemn, majestic, mournful, cinematic, soft moonlight.

Shot 4 — Petals:
White jasmine petals slowly falling in slow motion through a single soft beam of moonlight in darkness, dust particles glowing in the light, petals landing softly on an old wooden windowsill with a small candle. No people, no faces. Peaceful, mournful, poetic ending shot, cinematic, gentle fade toward darkness.

Settings: 9:16, 720p, 8s per shot, 0.7s crossfades, ~30s total.
